note: The suite disc psm-suite-s4: demo/psm/suite/build.py --tag s4 --list demo/psm/suite/suite_s4.json. A short menu: ao4 (the split-screen AO demo on simple scenes), Junior's three hud1c builds (the bisect of hud1b's hang at frame 1), and ao1 (the town's AO demo, as on s3). RUN ALL runs ao4 alone: a hud1c build may hang by design. Dropped from s3: c4g, r3-d, qr-q2, ao0 (their results are in), the town v1 builds a3e-auto, a3f-auto, bake1-auto, hud1b-auto, and a3e-t2 / a3e-poll. Times are ESTIMATE, not measured.
